theme.title: Beyond the Box Score
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: The 1969–70 Knicks set what was then a single-season record winning streak. How long was it?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Knicks had a then single-season NBA record 18 straight victories en route to 60–22 record

funFacts.text: That Knicks team also started the season at a record pace before Golden State broke its early-season mark decades later.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: They set the record for the best start in the first 24 games of a season at 23–1

funFacts.text: The Knicks went through Baltimore and Milwaukee before meeting the Lakers in the championship series.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: After defeating the Bullets in the Eastern Division semifinals and the Milwaukee Bucks in the Eastern Division finals

funFacts.text: Their title run later became the subject of the documentary When the Garden Was Eden.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Their journey was chronicled in various books and films, most recently in When the Garden was Eden

questions.prompt: In the lockout-shortened 2011–12 season, how many games did the Charlotte Bobcats win?
questions.note: Seven, the lowest winning percentage in NBA history.

funFacts.text: Michael Jordan owned Charlotte during its historically difficult season.
Gerald Henderson led the Bobcats in scoring with 15.1 points per game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Gerald Henderson led the team in scoring, with an average of 15.1 points per game

funFacts.text: Kemba Walker joined the team as a rookie after Charlotte selected him in the first round of the draft.

questions.prompt: In 1987–88 Danny Ainge became the first player with 100 threes in a season. How many did he make?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Danny Ainge was the first player to make over 100 three-pointers in a season in 1988, scoring 148 that season.

funFacts.text: Dale Ellis later became the first NBA player to hit a thousand career threes.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: In 1994, Ellis became the first NBA player to reach 1,000 career three-pointers

funFacts.text: John Starks was the first NBA player to make more than two hundred threes in one season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: In 1995, John Starks became the first player to make over 200 three-pointers in a season

funFacts.text: The three-pointer first appeared at the Olympics in Seoul, four years after FIBA introduced it.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: FIBA, introduced the three-point line in 1984, at 6.25 m (20 ft 6 in), and it made its Olympic debut in 1988

questions.prompt: How many assists per game did Jeff Teague average for the 2015 Hawks?
questions.note: 7.0 assists per game as Atlanta's starting point guard.

funFacts.text: Teague scored 15.9 points per game alongside his playmaking.
A hamstring injury cost Teague multiple games in December.
Teague paced Atlanta's scoring against Memphis in a January home win.

questions.prompt: Boston and Golden State set a Finals record for combined threes in Game 1 of 2022. How many?
questions.context: 2022 NBA Finals · Game 1 · at Golden State

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Both teams made a combined 40 three-pointers, the most ever in an NBA Finals game

funFacts.text: Al Horford finally reached his first Finals after years of playoff appearances, then led Boston's scoring in the opener.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: After playing 141 playoff games without an NBA Finals appearance

funFacts.text: The Celtics rallied in the fourth quarter after facing a double-digit deficit against the Warriors.
Jayson Tatum struggled to shoot in the opener but set a Finals-debut record for assists.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the most ever for a player in his Finals debut
